title: Agent OS User Profile
description: Personal data kept at ~/.agent-os/profile.json, for one person across all their projects. Kept apart from ~/.agent-os/defaults.json because that schema also describes the shared `extensions` field of .agent-os/config.json. Never contains credentials.

display_name.description: Name shown in the owner line of the tracker's commits comments (tracker-sync skill, Owner Name): one line, not blank. Takes priority over the tracker account's name. Set with /agent-os:setup or /agent-os:tracker owner.
